premises.text: The medical tourism industry is dominated by unvetted doctors and poor outcomes due to a lack of expertise.
premises.evidence_span: this lack of expertise, which for patients means unvetted doctors and poor outcomes, leads to a lack of trust.

premises.text: Patients travel for medical care to save money, save time, and gain access to procedures.
premises.evidence_span: the three main reasons patients travel for medical care. The first is to save money. The second is to save time. The third is to gain access.

premises.text: MedRepublic connects patients with vetted, English-speaking, board-certified doctors around the world.
premises.evidence_span: MedRepublic is an online global health marketplace that enables American and Canadian patients to connect with English-speaking, board-certified, top-rated doctors around the world.

premises.text: A strict vetting process ensures only qualified doctors are accepted into the MedRepublic network.
premises.evidence_span: Each of our doctors go through a strict vetting process led by our U.S. Board of Physicians.

premises.text: MedRepublic facilitates administrative tasks for doctors, allowing them to focus on patient care.
premises.evidence_span: MedRepublic does all the administrative work collecting documents, records, and payments so doctors can do what they do best.

premises.text: Patients can save a significant amount of money by using MedRepublic for medical procedures.
premises.evidence_span: Globally, she saved $140,000, which was just a quarter of the cost that she would have paid had she done the surgeries in the United States.
